def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize Category label variants (whitespace/case) to allowed values
    allowed = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]
    lookup = {a.lower(): a for a in allowed}
    df["Category"] = df["Category"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().map(lookup)
    # drop rows with invalid (negative/zero) quantity
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce") >= 1]
    # enforce Revenue = Quantity * Price (fixes cross-column inconsistencies)
    df["Quantity"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce")
    df["Price"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Price"], errors="coerce")
    df["Revenue"] = df["Quantity"] * df["Price"]
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["Category"])
    g = d.groupby("Category")["Revenue"].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
